teaser.en: Its Digo name adds *madzi*, water, because its fruit is juicier than that of its cousin, the plain *mfudu*.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linaongeza *madzi*, maji, kwa sababu tunda lake lina maji mengi kuliko la binamu yake, *mfudu* wa kawaida.

summary.en: *Mfudu madzi* is a small tree or shrub of bushland and wooded grassland with rusty-hairy leaves and watery, edible fruit. It grows at Mombasa, in the Shimba Hills and at Gazi.
summary.sw: *Mfudu madzi*, au mfudu maji, ni mti mdogo au kichaka cha vichakani na nyika zenye miti, wenye majani yenye manyoya ya rangi ya kutu na tunda lenye maji linaloliwa. Hukua Mombasa, katika Shimba Hills na Gazi.

about.en:
*Mfudu madzi* is a small tree or shrub of 3 to 6 metres. Its grey bark is cracked lengthwise into long fissures. The leaves are made of three to five leaflets spread like the fingers of a hand, covered in rusty hairs.

The fruits are small and juicy. Some people find them smelly, which gives the English name, smelly-berry fingerleaf.
about.sw:
*Mfudu madzi* ni mti mdogo au kichaka cha mita 3 hadi 6. Gome lake la kijivu limepasuka kwa urefu kwa mipasuko mirefu. Majani yake yameundwa na vijani vitatu hadi vitano vilivyotandazwa kama vidole vya mkono, vikiwa vimefunikwa na manyoya ya rangi ya kutu.

Matunda yake ni madogo na yenye maji mengi. Watu wengine huyaona yana harufu mbaya, na hapo ndipo jina la Kiingereza, *smelly-berry fingerleaf*, linapotoka.

where.en: It grows in bushland and wooded grassland at Mombasa, in the Shimba Hills and at Gazi.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka na nyika zenye miti huko Mombasa, katika Shimba Hills na Gazi.

uses.en: The watery fruit is eaten. The wood is used for poles and carved into spoons and pestles, and the flowers are good forage for bees.
uses.sw: Tunda lake lenye maji huliwa. Mti wake hutumika kwa nguzo na huchongwa kuwa miiko na michi, na maua yake ni lishe nzuri kwa nyuki.

culture.en: Pakia explains that *madzi*, 'water', marks its juicier fruit compared with the plain *mfudu*.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa *madzi*, 'maji', huonyesha kwamba tunda lake lina maji mengi kuliko la *mfudu* wa kawaida.

names.en: Pakia and Maundu and Tengnäs record the Digo name *mfudu madzi*, the 'watery *mfudu*', which Chonyi speakers share. In Swahili it is *mfudu maji*. In English it is the smelly-berry fingerleaf, and its scientific name is *Vitex mombassae*, named after Mombasa.
names.sw: Pakia, pamoja na Maundu na Tengnäs, wanarekodi jina la Kidigo *mfudu madzi*, '*mfudu* wa maji', ambalo wazungumzaji wa Kichonyi pia hulitumia. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mfudu maji*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *smelly-berry fingerleaf*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Vitex mombassae*, lililotokana na Mombasa.

reason.en: Same genus; the plain mfudu it is compared with
reason.sw: Jenasi moja; ndio mfudu wa kawaida unaolinganishwa nao

reason.en: Another wild fruit of the coastal bush
reason.sw: Tunda jingine la porini la vichaka vya pwani
